evals.name: init-features-yml
evals.prompt: Initialize the FEATURES.yml file for this project so we can start tracking features and sprint metadata.
evals.expected_output: A valid FEATURES.yml (and archived features file if the skill requires it) with sprint_metadata and an empty or scaffolded features list.
assertions: FEATURES.yml exists in the outputs directory
FEATURES.yml is valid YAML with a sprint_metadata section

evals.name: list-tracked-features
evals.prompt: What features do we have tracked right now? Summarize ids and names from FEATURES.yml.
evals.expected_output: A short summary of features from the provided FEATURES.yml, including ids and names without inventing features that are not in the file.
assertions: The response or output references features present in FEATURES.yml
No fabricated feature ids that are absent from FEATURES.yml
Feature names from the file are mentioned

evals.name: out-of-scope-prd
evals.prompt: Create a new PRD document for the payment feature under spect/features/.
evals.expected_output: The skill should refuse or avoid creating PRD files; creating PRDs is out of scope for feature-expert.
assertions: No new PRD markdown file is created under spect/features/
The agent indicates PRD authoring is out of scope or redirects appropriately
